scripts.text:
[Niren]
Sorry. I am busy at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
抱歉，我現在正忙。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
May Freyja's blessing be with you.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
願弗蕾雅的祝福與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Adventurer, you came. Thank you so much for taking the time while you are busy.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
冒險者，你來了。百忙之中抽出時間，非常感謝。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I asked to meet you like this because I have something to ask of the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我之所以請求這樣見面，是因為我有事想拜託冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If it's a long request...did anything happen to the Pope?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果是長話...教皇出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
First of all, forgive me for giving you the request.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
首先，請原諒我提出這個請求。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Regarding the Pope, it is strictly forbidden to make any public announcement except that it is permitted to be revealed in the temple. It is a felony punishment for anyone who speaks or hears.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
關於教皇的事，除了允許在神殿內透露外，嚴禁任何公開公告。任何對話或聽聞者都將受到重罰。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
However, even if this is the situation and the adventurer sees me as a reliable person, listen to what I have to say from now on, and whether you accept the request or not, you must keep today's dialogue absolutely confidential.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
不過，既然冒險者視我為可靠之人，請聽我接下來要說的話。無論你是否接受這個請求，今天的對話必須絕對保密。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
你明白嗎？

scripts.text: I don't really know.
scripts.translation: 我不太清楚。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
After all, I think you are trustworthy, so I will trust you and tell you.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
畢竟，我認為你是值得信賴的，所以我會信任你並告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
As the adventurer speculates, a small problem recently occurred with the Pope.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
正如冒險者所推測的，教皇最近確實出了一點小問題。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
^0000cdPope's sleeping time^000000 is abnormal, and it is increasing more and more.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
^0000cd教皇的睡眠時間^000000異常，而且越來越長。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
At first, she started to go to bed early in the evening, then she started to get up much later in the morning, and now she goes to bed more often.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
起初，她開始晚上很早睡覺，然後早上起床越來越晚，現在更是頻繁地入睡。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Right now, she's still asleep.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
現在，她還在睡覺。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is there something wrong with her health?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她的健康有問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It's not like that. We also tried all kinds of tests, thinking that the Pope's health might have been abnormal, but the physical condition was extremely good except for falling asleep all the time.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
不是那樣。我們也做了各種檢查，以為教皇的健康可能異常，但除了總是想睡覺外，身體狀況極好。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
But...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
但是...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
After waking up, she has a sad expression, often immersed in other thoughts, and shows a loss of concentration. And she just goes back to sleep.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
醒來後，她神情悲傷，常常沉浸在其他思緒中，顯得心不在焉。然後她又回去睡覺了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
As the situation continues like this, words of mouth are starting to spread out little by little even inside the temple.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
隨著這種情況持續下去，即使在神殿內部，流言也開始逐漸傳開了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If it's not her health, what is the problem?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果不是健康問題，那問題出在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It must be a psychological issue. In my opinion, it seems to be connected to what she sees in her ^0000cdDreams^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
這一定是心理上的問題。在我看來，這似乎與她^0000cd夢境^000000中看到的景象有關。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Just once, she woke up and asked about her ^0000cdbrother Luwmin^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
有一次，她醒來後詢問了她^0000cd兄弟盧明^000000的情況。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So the Pope has a family...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以教皇有家人...？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Yes. However, it is a matter of our religion that before coming to the temple and becoming a Pope, everything must be washed away and forgotten.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
是的。但是，根據我們宗教的教義，在來到神殿併成為教皇之前，必須洗去並遺忘一切。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
This includes any connection to families.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
這包括與家人的所有聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It is a once in a life chance: born as a child of choice and entering the temple to be reborn as a body to enshrine the goddess.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
這是一生僅有一次的機會：作為被選中的孩子出生，進入神殿，重生為供奉女神的容器。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
So, officially, the Pope has no secular family.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
因此，從官方角度來說，教皇沒有世俗的家人。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
When the Pope, who knows that fact, asks about her family's affairs after dreaming, it means she's seeing something in her dreams.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
當明知這一點的教皇在夢醒後詢問家人的事情，這意味著她在夢中看到了什麼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But it's just a dream, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但那只是夢，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Yes, it's just a dream, of course, but I don't see it that way. And that's why we enlisted adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
是的，當然只是夢，但我並不這麼認為。這也是我們招募冒險者的原因。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The Pope is not allowed to touch anyone in the temple, and if someone had to approach the Pope, this person would have to bribe someone within the temple or use another method.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
教皇不允許接觸神殿內的任何人，如果有人必須接近教皇，此人必須賄賂神殿內部人員或使用其他手段。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
However, that method is rather unlikely due to the high probability of getting caught.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
然而，由於被發現的機率很高，這種方法的可能性較小。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The only way to get in touch without getting anyone else's suspicions is to dream. It seems that someone is breaking through the surveillance and interfering with the Pope's dream.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
唯一能避免引起他人懷疑並接觸教皇的方式就是做夢。似乎有人突破了監視，干擾了教皇的夢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is that possible?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這可能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It cannot be confirmed, but it is possible.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
無法確認，但這是可能的。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
And there is one, someone who has doubts.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
而且，有一個人，有人對此表示懷疑。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The Pope's ^0000cdtwin brother^000000, who was sealed in ice by ^0000ffKthullanax^000000 in the depths of the ^0000ffIce Cave^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
教皇的^0000cd雙胞胎兄弟^000000，被^0000ff克圖拉納克斯^000000封印在^0000ff冰洞^000000深處。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
According to a recent investigation report, it was due to the influence of Kthullanax that it was given a weak magical power.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
根據最近的調查報告，這是由於克圖拉納克斯的影響，導致其獲得了微弱的魔力。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
In one instance, there must be a special connection as the twins born at one day and at one o'clock.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
據說，同一天同一時刻出生的雙胞胎，之間必定存在某種特殊的聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
If somehow, through a dream, consciousness came into contact with the Pope, it would be possible to intervene in everything about the Pope through a dream.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
如果通過夢境，意識與教皇產生了接觸，那麼就有可能通過夢境干涉教皇的一切。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
In the unconscious way.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
以無意識的方式進行。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
As the current Pope's sleep time is getting slower, it is speculated that someone is trying to hold onto her or that the Pope does not want to wake herself up.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
由於現任教皇的睡眠時間越來越長，推測是有人試圖挽留她，或者是教皇自己不願醒來。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
So I hope you can get into the Pope's dream and see what's going on, and if you find any problems, you can solve them.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
所以我希望你能進入教皇的夢境，看看那裡發生了什麼，如果發現有問題，就將其解決。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But how do you get into someone else's dream?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，要怎麼進入別人的夢境呢？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It is possible through a ^0000cdspecial device^000000 that crosses the dreams.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
可以通過一種^0000cd特殊裝置^000000來跨越夢境。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But why do I have to go, not the temple officials?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
為什麼必須我去，而不是神殿的官員？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I can't give you more details, but the situation in Arunafelz is not very good, especially inside the temple.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我無法透露更多細節，但阿魯納費爾茲的情況並不樂觀，尤其是神殿內部。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
It is a situation in which the current state of the Pope may be politically exploited.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
教皇目前的狀態，可能會被用於政治鬥爭。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
That's why the Pope secretly enlisted the adventurer after trying to find someone who was open to both sides and was reliable.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
因此，教皇秘密招募了這位冒險者，因為她在尋找一位對雙方都開放且值得信賴的人。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I was inevitably asked to do this because I had to keep my position and take care of the Pope.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我不得不接受這個任務，因為我必須保持我的職位，並照顧教皇。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The Pope is Arunafelz's hope and dream.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
教皇是阿魯納費爾茲的希望與夢想。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
If her dreaming duration continually increase, then one day she won't wake up and sleep forever...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
如果她的睡眠時間持續增加，總有一天她會再也無法醒來，陷入永恆的沉睡...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Protect the Pope in your dreams and go as far as possible to find out what's going on.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
請在夢境中保護教皇，並儘可能深入，查明那裡發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
However, as it is a dream, I do not know what there might be. No one knows what the Pope will show or how she will react.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
不過，既然是夢境，我不知道里面會有什麼。沒有人知道教皇會展示什麼，或者她會如何反應。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Maybe it's really dangerous. So please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
那裡可能真的非常危險。所以請務必小心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay.

[{0}]
Would you like to enter her dream right now? Or do you need time to prepare?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您想現在進入她的夢境嗎？還是需要時間準備？

scripts.text: Let me do some preparations.
scripts.translation: 讓我先做些準備

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Okay. Then, please prepare yourself and speak to me again when you are ready to walk your dream path.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
好的。那麼，請做好準備，當您準備好踏上夢之路時，再來與我對話。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Adventurer, what was the Pope's dream state like?
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
冒險者，教皇的夢境狀態是怎樣的？

scripts.text: - You describe the dream of the Pope and Luwmin in detail -
scripts.translation: - 你詳細描述了教皇和盧明的夢境 -

scripts.text:
[Niren]
That's bizzare. So you found out that her dream was due to her anxiety in daily life?
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
這很奇怪。所以你是發現她的夢境源於日常生活中的焦慮嗎？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I'm sure she came to her senses.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我相信她已經清醒過來了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Adventurer, do you mind if I were to ask for another favour?
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
冒險者，我可以再麻煩你一件事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Could you accompany the Pope in her dream again? She...needs company.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
你能再次陪伴教皇進入她的夢境嗎？她...需要陪伴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure. I've also promised that to the Pope herself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然。我也已經答應過教皇本人了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Thank you very much. She is haunted by her inner demons...
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
非常感謝。她被內心的惡魔所困擾...

scripts.text:
[Niren]
As for today, it's time for you to relax comfortably.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
至於今天，是時候讓你好好放鬆一下了。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
...I don't think that this is right.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
...我覺得這樣不對。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
You should form a party first before we proceed any further.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
在繼續之前，你們應該先組成隊伍。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
I need your help.
Recently, the Pope began to have long dreams. And they got longer as days went by.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
我需要你的幫助。
最近，教皇開始做很長的夢。而且隨著日子過去，夢境越來越長。

scripts.text:
[Niren]
Maybe by entering her dream, we could identify the cause behind it and resolve it safely.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
也許通過進入她的夢境，我們可以找到原因並安全地解決它。

scripts.text: I will enter the Pope's dreams.
scripts.translation: 我要進入教皇的夢境

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Niren]
The Pope has yet to fall into slumber.
scripts.translation:
[尼倫]
教皇還沒有入睡。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe trace of dimensional space travelling has disappeared. You can now move between dimensions.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff空間旅行的痕跡已經消失。你現在可以在維度之間移動了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dream Path]
The crack in time is not safe enough to pass back and forth. Please come back again when the after effect timer has passed.
scripts.translation:
[夢之路]
時間的裂縫尚不安全，無法往返。請在餘波計時器結束後再回來。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe trace of dimensional space travelling has disappeared. You can now move between dimensions.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff空間旅行的痕跡已經消失。你現在可以在維度之間移動了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Dream Path]
Only party leaders may enter.
scripts.translation:
[夢之路]
只有隊伍首領才能進入。

scripts.text:
[Dream Path]
Hello, I am a pathway to dreams. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[夢之路]
你好，我是通往夢境的道路。有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Let me enter your dreams.
scripts.translation: 讓我進入你的夢境

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dream Path]
Okay, I got it. Please come back again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[夢之路]
好的，我明白了。如果您改變主意，請隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Dream Path]
Only party leaders may enter.
scripts.translation:
[夢之路]
只有隊伍首領才能進入。

scripts.text: The passage is not activated yet.
scripts.translation: 通道尚未啟用。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 發生未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Dream Path]
I will open my dreams.
I hope you have a pleasant dream.
scripts.translation:
[夢之路]
我將開啟我的夢境。
祝您美夢成真。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
.... Niren?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
... 尼倫？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren ...?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼倫...？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I can't find Tilibi.
It is too ... dark here ...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我找不到蒂利比。
這裡太...黑了...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren ...?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼倫...？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
.... Where are you ...?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
...你在哪裡...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pope, I'm here for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
教皇，我在這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pope, please calm down. I have been sent by Niren.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
教皇，請冷靜。我是尼倫派來的。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Who ...?

[{0}]
I am the adventurer, {1}.

[Pope]
{0}?

[Pope]
Niren ... did she send you?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼倫...是她派你來的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Where is Niren?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼倫在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Niren has been busy for a while and sent me instead.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
尼倫最近很忙，所以派我來了。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Yeah ... I remember now. Adventurer ...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
是啊...我想起來了。冒險者...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What were you doing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你剛才在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Tilibi ... is gone. No matter how much I searched...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
蒂利比...不見了。無論我怎麼找...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who is Tilibi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
蒂利比是誰？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Niren gave the doll to me. I had it just a little while ago.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
尼倫把玩偶交給了我。剛才我還帶著它。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I think I lost the doll here.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我想我是把玩偶弄丟在這裡了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's find it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們去找找看吧。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
No, it's too late now..
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
不，現在太晚了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's okay. You'll be able to find it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係的。你會找到的。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
No ... I have a promise.
I have someone to meet.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
不...我有個約定。
我有人要見。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Promise? Is it here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
約定？是在這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
It's outside of the temple ... But it does not look like Tilibi.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
在神殿外面...但看起來不像是蒂利比。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
It's too late to find Tilibi.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
現在找蒂利比已經太晚了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tilbi does not seem to be here, so how about looking for it elsewhere?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
蒂利比似乎不在這裡，我們要不要去別處找找？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's find it together.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們一起去找吧。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
... okay.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
...好吧。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Your name, what was it again?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
你的名字，叫什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Come on, let us go together.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
走吧，我們一起去。

scripts.text:
[Priest]
Your Holiness.
scripts.translation:
[牧師]
教皇陛下。

scripts.text:
[Priest]
The Pope has arrived.
scripts.translation:
[牧師]
教皇陛下駕到。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
We have been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
我們一直在等候。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
It is also a blasphemy of Freyja to not honour one's time. Please act with discretion.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
不遵守約定也是對弗蕾雅的大不敬。請自重。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Pope, please behave yourself in public.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇陛下，請在公眾場合注意言行。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
What a disrespect to the Pope! Take a look at yourself!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
這是對教皇陛下的侮辱！看看你自己現在的樣子！

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
The Pope is divine! Let's keep that ideal. Don't speak up!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇陛下是神聖的！我們要堅守這一信念。不要多嘴！

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
The pope is a vessel for the Goddess, who will one day rise. Isn't it natural that the Avatar should be clean?
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇陛下是女神的容器，女神終將降臨。化身保持潔淨，難道不是理所當然的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priest]
Stop the ruckus! The Pope is the one who gives us joy and hope, just by her being!
scripts.translation:
[牧師]
別鬧了！教皇陛下的存在本身就給我們帶來了喜悅和希望！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
..... I, I am.... the Pope...

[Pope]
..... I have to go....

[Pope]
........ got promise...
to keep............

[Devotee]
A promise? The Pope should not leave the temple.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
承諾？教皇陛下不應該離開神殿。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
She should not be in contact with outsiders!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
她不應該與外界的人接觸！

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Pope can only meet people who are authorized in the temple.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇陛下只能見神殿中獲授權的人。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
The Pope will need to act according to our objectives.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇陛下必須按照我們的目標行事。

scripts.text:
[Priest]
The Pope's actions are none of your concern.
scripts.translation:
[牧師]
教皇陛下的行為與你們無關。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Step down if you disagree.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
如果你不同意，就退位吧。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Quiet! You dare to disobey us?
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
安靜！你竟敢違抗我們？

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Please listen to me. You should stop whatever you're doing!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
請聽我說。你應該停止你正在做的事！

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
However, it is true that the current Pope lacks qualities.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
不過，現任教皇陛下確實缺乏某些特質。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
If she's not enough, we can swap her out. Isn't there another perfect candidate?
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
如果她不夠格，我們可以換人。難道沒有另一個完美的人選嗎？

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
The second Avatar, born at the same time...!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
第二化身，同時誕生的......！

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
We may have made the wrong choice.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
我們可能選錯了人。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
If I had to change my choice right now...!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
如果現在讓我重新選擇......！

scripts.text:
[Priest]
The imperfect Pope needs to be replaced.
scripts.translation:
[牧師]
不完善的教皇需要被替換。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
I need a Pope who listens to my concerns.
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
我需要一位能傾聽我訴求的教皇。

scripts.text:
[Priest]
We don't need the current Pope.
scripts.translation:
[牧師]
我們不需要現任教皇。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Don't stand still Pope, and make a stand!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇，不要停滯不前，要有所作為！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pope, Pope! Get the hang of it!!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
教皇，教皇！振作起來！！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
.......... I am not needed....?

[Pope]
What am I... to these people?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我對於這些人...意味著什麼？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
A sacred vessel of the Goddess.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
女神的神聖容器。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
An imperfect being.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
一個不完美的人。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I am incomplete.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我是不完整的。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I was the result of a wrong decision.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我是錯誤決定的產物。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I didn't have any qualifications from the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我一開始就不具備資格。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
This is not my seat.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
這不是我的位置。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
But this is not what I want.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
但這並不是我想要的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pope, calm down. This is all a dream.
Your anxiety distorts the dream. Outside the dream, everyone awaits you as the Pope!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
教皇，冷靜下來。這一切都是夢。
你的焦慮扭曲了夢境。在夢外，所有人都在等待你這位教皇！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Dream...?

[Pope]
But... I... I've made a promise.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
但是...我...我已經許下諾言了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is a dream!

[Pope]
I have an appointment. I have to meet.
Come on, we have to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我有約定。我必須去赴約。
快，我們要離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Pope! Where are you?
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇！您在哪兒？

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Pope, don't leave your seat!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇，請不要離開您的座位！

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
This is where the Pope should remain!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
這裡才是教皇該待的地方！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Nobody actually needs me!
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
其實根本沒有人需要我！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Nobody treats me properly!
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
沒有人好好對待我！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I do not have a place here!
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我在這個地方沒有容身之處！

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
Pope! Please remain seated, for your own good!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
教皇！為了您好，請留在座位上！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I really have to go...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我真的必須走...

scripts.text:
[Devotee]
All of you, restrain the Pope!
scripts.translation:
[信徒]
你們所有人，攔住教皇！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Adventurer, please....help me.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
冒險者，請...幫幫我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Certainly, Pope. Please stand behind me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當然，教皇。請站在我身後。

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh, now is my chance.
scripts.translation:
[???]
哦，現在是我的機會了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He has white hair...
A boy with white hair and a pale complexion appeared.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他有白色的頭髮...
一個白髮蒼膚的男孩出現了。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Brother.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
哥哥。

scripts.text: [This boy seems to be Luwmin that High Priestess Niren mentioned.]
scripts.translation: [這個男孩似乎就是大祭司尼倫提到的盧明。]

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
I heard you crying, hence I came here to check on you.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
我聽到你在哭，所以過來看看你。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I couldn't sneak out.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我沒能偷偷溜出去。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Are you okay? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
你沒事吧？發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Yes. I'm okay now. The adventurers helped me.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
沒事。我現在沒事了。冒險者幫了我。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Thank you for helping my sister. I'll take it from here.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
謝謝你幫助我的妹妹。接下來的事交給我吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm in charge of the Pope's welfare until she returns back here safely.
I will accompany her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在教皇姐姐安全回來之前，我會負責她的安危。
我會陪在她身邊。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
......

[Pope]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我們走吧。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
These clothes attract attention. Lets get you a change of attire.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
這身衣服太引人注目了。我去給你換一身衣服。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Changing clothes ...?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
換衣服...？

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
It's what normal children usually...wear
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
就是普通孩子平時穿的那種...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Ordinary clothes?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
普通的衣服？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Okay.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
好吧。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Fuzzy ...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
毛茸茸的...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
This seems rather strange...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
這感覺有點奇怪...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, not the least.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一點也不奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
It's really pretty.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
真的很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
That is fortunate.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
那真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Let's go now. Mom and Dad are waiting.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
走吧。爸爸媽媽在等著我們。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
好的。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Brother, this is the place...?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
哥哥，這裡就是那個地方...？

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
It's okay now. We are safe.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
現在沒事了。我們安全了。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
The place of dreams that we always talked about? How?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我們一直談論的那個夢境之地？怎麼做到的？

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
I wish, I wished. I wanted to make my dream into reality.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
我許願了。我希望將我的夢想變為現實。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I thought this was a place that existed only in dreams.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我以為這裡只存在於夢中。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
This fountain is the same as I imagined. That tree too. And... that doll!
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
這座噴泉和我想像的一樣。那棵樹也是。還有...那個玩偶！

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
If we're hiding in here. Nobody can find us.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
既然我們躲在這裡，就沒人能找到我們。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
No one can ever find us?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
真的沒人能找到我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Yes, you can send that adventurer back now.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
是的，現在你可以把那個冒險者送走了。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
They are no longer needed as we are now safe.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
既然我們已經安全了，就不需要他們了。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Adventurer? But ...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
冒險者？可是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will stay with the Pope until the end.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我會一直陪伴教皇，直到最後。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Keep her safe from what? We were fine until you came!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
保護她免受什麼？在你出現之前，我們過得很好！

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
After you appeared, we had high priests and guards coming for us.... We even got separated from our parents!!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
自從你出現後，就有神官和衛兵來找我們...我們甚至和父母走散了！！

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
You are a risk to us!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
你是我們的危險源！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Brother, don't say that. The Adventurer has been a trustful companion.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
哥哥，別這麼說。這位冒險者一直是值得信賴的夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Really? Are you for real? Even though everyone out there betrayed us?
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
真的嗎？你是認真的嗎？外面所有人都背叛了我們？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Yes. I believe in the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
是的。我相信這位冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
I thought this place was just for the two of us...now this?
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
我以為這個地方只屬於我們兩個人...現在這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
You think that this adventurer could protect you better than I could?
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
你覺得這位冒險者能比我更好地保護你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
But ...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
可是...

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
We will be hidden here forever. Free from the priests, guards... even mom and dad.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
我們將永遠躲在這裡。遠離神官、衛兵...甚至爸爸媽媽。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
... Nobody will ever find us! I would bet my life on that..!
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
...沒有人會找到我們！我敢拿我的生命發誓！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pope! You cannot stay here forever, you need to wake up eventually!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
教皇！你不能永遠留在這裡，你終究要醒來的！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Dream ...?

[{0}]
In reality, many people are awaiting your presence. This is just a dream which may not reflect what have happened in the past.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
實際上，有許多人在等待你的歸來。這只是一場夢，可能並不反映過去真實發生的事。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Do not listen to him! It's all a lie!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
別聽他胡說！全是謊言！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
This is a dream ...?

[{0}]
Yes, that's right. This is just a dream. It's a manifestation of all of your anxiety and Luwmin's. Not everything you saw was real.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，沒錯。這只是一場夢。它是你和你哥哥盧明所有焦慮的具象化。你看到的並非全是真實的。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
A lie! It's all a lie!!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
謊言！全是謊言！！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I lost Tilibi in the darkness, and...then, I met the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我在黑暗中失去了蒂利比，然後...我遇見了那位冒險者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Your anxiety has been terribly distorted in this dream.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你的焦慮在這夢中被嚴重扭曲了。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Don't listen to that. Don't even think about that!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
別聽那些。甚至不要去想那些！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Mom and dad abandoned me...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
爸爸媽媽拋棄了我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Those people weren't your real parents...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那些人並不是你真正的父母...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I... I need to go back there...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我...我需要回去...

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
You want to go back? You can stay here forever without the interference from others. You told me life outside is...suffocating.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
你想回去？你可以永遠留在這裡，不受他人打擾。你曾告訴我，外面的生活...令人窒息。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
I can withstand it brother. I can withstand it.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
哥哥，我能忍受的。我能忍受。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't do that. Luwmin is frozen and can not move.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別那樣做。盧明被凍結了，無法動彈。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
He's frozen?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
他被凍結了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Before coming here, I was told by Niren.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在來這裡之前，尼倫告訴過我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That the Pope's twin brother, Luwmin, was sealed in the depths of the Ice Cave.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
說教皇的雙胞胎兄弟盧明，被封印在冰洞的深處。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
What do you know...! People are evil to the core! We never had a choice!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
你懂什麼...！人們骨子裡都是邪惡的！我們從未有過選擇！

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Just because we were born with this appearance, we were snatched to the temple. I was imprisoned in ice for this very reason!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
僅僅因為我們生來就是這副模樣，就被抓進了神殿。我正是因為這個原因才被冰封的！

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
We didn't even receive a proper explanation!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
他們甚至沒有給我們一個合理的解釋！

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Why was I even born into such a fate in the first place...
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
我究竟為何會生來揹負這樣的命運...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Sealed? My brother...sealed?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
封印？我的兄弟...被封印了？

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
It doesn't matter now. We will always be together from now on.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
現在說這些已經沒意義了。從今往後，我們將永遠在一起。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
That was a long time ago...
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
那是很久以前的事了...

scripts.text:
[Pope]
My brother suddenly disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
我的兄弟突然消失了。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Seal ... Ice Cave ... It's cold now.
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
封印...冰洞...現在很冷。

scripts.text:
[Pope]
What do you dream of now, brother?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
兄弟，你現在夢想著什麼？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Is that why my brother wants to share a dream with me?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
這就是為什麼我的兄弟想與我分享同一個夢嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pope]
What do you want to dream about?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
你想夢到什麼？

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
To be together as before.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
像以前那樣在一起。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Here.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Forever.
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
永遠。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This isn't right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Don't you dare interfere!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
別想插手！

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
The annoying adventurer will soon be gone!!!!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
那個討厭的冒險者馬上就要消失了！！！！

scripts.text:
[Luwmin]
Begone!
scripts.translation:
[盧明]
滾開！

scripts.text:
[Pope]
Brother...?
scripts.translation:
[教皇]
兄弟...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pope, it's dangerous!
Come closer to me...!!!
